docs.summary: Geometry a host draws into each view without making renderables: particles, terrain patches, GPU generated draws. Its items join the view's passes like renderables, opaque ones in the prepass and opaque pass, transparent ones sorted with the world's, and any pass type a feature draws. [`Extract`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.RenderProvider~Extract) runs on the host thread at SubmitFrame, [`Cull`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.RenderProvider~Cull) on the render thread once per view.
The kinds of view it draws into, read at SubmitFrame.
Copies what Cull reads. Host thread, at SubmitFrame.
